newsitem.title: USA: US spot LPGs bump up in line with NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: US spot LPGs bump up in line with NYMEX.

text.p: U.S. spot LPG prices bumped up slightly during late trade on Thursday, tracking stronger NYMEX crude oil and natural gas futures amid some buying interest, traders said.
"We drifted down a bit this morning but then buyers came back in and with crude up, we got a little stronger," said one Houston trader.
Dipping a half cent at midday, spot propane in Mont Belvieu, Texas, hub rose a quarter cent in late trade to between 41.50 cents and 42.00 cents a gallon, players said.
41.75 cent and 41.50 cents parcels were sold.
Conway, Kansas, hub also firmed slightly to 40.75/41.00 cents as NYMEX October crude oil futures ended up 20 cents at $23.44 a barrel.
The bid price for Belvieu purity ethane rose a quarter cent to 27.75 cents, with sellers remaining at 28.00 cents. Ethane mix rose to maintain its one cent spread, traders said.
Players said stronger NYMEX October natgas futures, which ended up 4.5 cents, pressured the material higher.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859-1631
